title: OES-32-v2: a locked-protocol evaluation of a transparent residual/window detector on NASA SMAP/MSL (negative result)
description: Locked-protocol, validation-only selection and a single test run of OES-32-v2 on the NASA SMAP/MSL benchmark. OES-32-v2 did not meet its predeclared improvement criterion (validation runtime ratio 2.27 > 2; test v2 minus v1 event F1 -0.166 SMAP, -0.001 MSL). Research software; offline benchmark mode; not an operational detection system. Raw data are not included (download from the telemanom source and verify with data/dataset_manifest.json).
notes: Unreleased: no publication date set. Set publication_date at deposit time.
